candidates.title: Stop Letting AI Agents Just Chat
candidates.description: Are your AI agents actually working or just wasting compute? Discover why Paperclip treats agents like employees with structured tasks instead of aimless chatter. How are you managing your AI workforce? Let us know below!
candidates.transcript: In Paperclip, your agents become employees. You give them managers, you assign them tasks. They can talk to each other, but it's not what you think. It's through the task, intentional and focused. I haven't seen a lot of super value out of like agent conference room or an agent town where you just set your agents to sit there and talk to each other.
candidates.hook_reason: This clip clearly explains the unique value proposition of Paperclip as a 'meta harness' for managing AI agents as employees, which is a compelling hook for tech-focused viewers.

candidates.description: Stop worrying about the latest AI model updates. Paperclip acts as a meta-harness, allowing you to integrate any new model or feature seamlessly. Are you ready to future-proof your workflow? Let us know in the comments!
candidates.transcript: We're harness maxing. No matter what new harness comes out or model, paperclip is a meta harness. We can bring any other harness or model to it. Paperclip can use it. Paperclip is our company, and it's a company that can run the greatest and latest models, and the greatest and latest harnesses, and all the features they come out with. Just think about that. Doesn't that make you excited to try this? It does. Coffee break.

candidates.title: Watch AI Agents Talk to Each Other! 🤖
candidates.description: See the magic of Paperclip in action as agents delegate tasks to one another in real-time. This is the future of autonomous workflows! Have you ever seen AI collaborate like this? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.
candidates.transcript: Here, what you're about to see is one of the most powerful parts of Paperclip, and it's how we talk with our agents, how we interface with them. And that's through tasks. Now, we're about to assign our toilet task. But first, I want to just test this and make sure it works. Cuz so far, we haven't even talked to our agents, and our agents haven't talked to each other. We're going to do both of those right now. So, we'll set up a task and assign it to Dumbledore. Just to say, "Hey, why don't you talk to Ron? Test Ron, make sure he works." So, we'll set up our task and go. And within moments, watch what happens here. Boom, Dumbledore assigns a task to Ron. And that right there is our first moment where we talk to an agent and then an agent talk to another agent. And they're both working here. Dumbledore is actually waiting and then when Ron finishes his task, Dumbledore is like, "Hey, we tested, we're good." Isn't that sick? Now, some movie magic's about to happen.
candidates.hook_reason: This clip demonstrates the practical, hands-on power of the tool by showing agents delegating tasks to each other, which is the core 'wow' factor of the video.

candidates.description: Stop doing repetitive tasks manually! See how you can set up AI routines to handle server checks, daily reports, and automated decision-making in seconds. How would you use an AI assistant to save time in your day? Let us know in the comments!
